title: Understanding the Dataset
text: The dataset contains information about what students ate for lunch, including the foods, servings, and total calories. Each row represents a student's lunch on a specific day.

title: Linear Regression Model
text: The linear regression model is used to predict the number of calories based on previous days' calorie intake. The model has parameters for the intercept and the calories from the previous two days.

title: $$fit_{intercept}$$ Argument
text: The $$fit_{intercept}$$ argument in the LinearRegression function determines whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to True, the model will calculate the intercept.
